summary: Entegra Procurement Services is a Sodexo-owned group purchasing organization (GPO) for hospitality and restaurant businesses, claiming roughly $42 billion in aggregated purchasing power to negotiate lower costs on goods and services for operators, saving restaurants up to 30% on purchases per its own materials. (Scope note: Savings percentage is a vendor-stated range, not independently audited.)
In 2026 Entegra acquired Prestige Purchasing, a UK-based procurement specialist serving hospitality, restaurant, and leisure operators, to accelerate growth in the UK hospitality procurement market.
Entegra combines purchasing scale, spend analytics, culinary expertise, procurement technology, and operational consulting as its core value proposition to hospitality operators.
